title: Apple Lockdown Mode
why: A restrictive security mode changes app capabilities; developer_settings is only an approximate existing key.

title: Secure Enclave availability
why: Secure Enclave service presence is distinct from firmware boot mode; it varies with the claimed hardware.

title: Application installer provenance
why: Receipt metadata absence is a low-confidence signal and is not the same condition as jailbreak status. App-scoped provenance remains unavailable.

title: Application device binding
why: An app-enrolled identity and attestation service are required. Shell-visible device identity cannot authenticate the binding.

title: Active VPN interface
why: An addressed tunnel is distinct from an interception proxy. System tunnels and private relay can match the same condition.

title: Screen lock configuration
why: No portable shell command establishes passcode state; the nearest developer_settings key is approximate.
